atoms.text:
Tod the timid little fish swam around his coral reef home and stayed away from danger. But Tod the little fish was so timid that he was scared to make friends.

Tod’s mum said, “You should go explore other sections of the reef!”

Tod answered, “But mum, what if Mr Eel is awake and hasn’t eaten yet?”

Tod’s mum said, “Honey, nobody wants to eat you. Mr Eel is nice!”

Tod decided to swim to the next coral. Suddenly, a huge whale swam by.

The whale saw Tod and said, “I’ve never seen you before! Do you want to swim with me today?”

Tod was very happy and said, “Yes! I like to swim. I’ll join you.”

Now Tod swims with Mr Whale and is not timid any more.
